_comment: Optional deployment release proposal. Set a new semantic version and notes before deploying; Avenue Guard will DM the configured owner and publish it only after approval. Leave version blank when no automatic proposal is needed.
title: Components V2 Interface
summary: Rebuilds every rich Avenue Guard message with native Components V2 containers while preserving all workflow behavior
changes: Converted all outgoing embeds into modern accent containers with structured text, separators and clearer information hierarchy
Integrated existing buttons and select menus into V2 action rows without changing callbacks, custom IDs or persistent behavior
Added native thumbnail, media-gallery and visible file components for images, evidence, transcripts and report attachments
Moved release and ban-information identity recovery to durable database records instead of rendered embed fields
Updated sticky, weekly-offer and transcript readers to understand both Components V2 and historical classic embeds
Kept the V2 rendering boundary active across restarts so already-converted messages remain safely editable
Added Components V2 regression coverage and a dedicated visual architecture guide
